explain.say: Computer chips are built on wafers, thin discs of extremely pure silicon. Silicon comes from quartz, which is silicon joined to oxygen; a furnace with carbon pulls the oxygen away.

explain.say: The pure silicon is melted, and a small seed crystal is dipped in and slowly pulled up while turning. Atoms line up on the seed, growing one perfect crystal cylinder, an ingot, up to about 2 metres long.

explain.say: Wire saws slice the ingot into wafers less than a millimetre thick, about 0.775 millimetres for standard 300 millimetre wafers. They are polished flatter than almost anything else people make, so tiny chip patterns can be printed sharply.

faq.q: How pure is silicon for chips?
faq.a: Chip-grade silicon is about 99.9999999 percent pure, called nine nines, or even purer. Even tiny traces of other atoms would change how electricity flows and ruin the transistors.
asks: Why does silicon need to be so pure?

faq.a: It is how single-crystal silicon is grown. A seed crystal touches the surface of molten silicon and is slowly pulled up and rotated, so the silicon freezes onto it with every atom lined up in one perfect crystal.
asks: How is a silicon ingot grown?

faq.q: How thin is a silicon wafer?
faq.a: A standard 300 millimetre wafer is about 0.775 millimetres thick, roughly the thickness of a credit card. Wafers are thinned further after the chips are made.
asks: How big is a silicon wafer?

faq.q: Why must a wafer be so flat?
faq.a: Chip patterns are printed with light through lenses that focus on a very thin layer. If the wafer were not flat to within billionths of a metre, parts of the pattern would be out of focus.
asks: How flat is a silicon wafer?

faq.a: The ingot is pulled from the melt while rotating, so it grows as a cylinder, and slicing a cylinder gives round discs. Square chips are then cut from the round wafer.
asks: Why are wafers round when chips are square?

facts: The Czochralski crystal-growing method was discovered by Jan Czochralski in 1916.
Standard 300 mm silicon wafers are 0.775 mm thick.
